**Megaspeed Says Suspected China Spy Left in 2025**
Megaspeed stated that a suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left the company in 2025, according to a BBC Business report. The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China despite US restrictions. This information is based solely on RSS data; the full article was not fetched and this represents a single source without independent confirmation.
